summary: Your deputy files against you: {deputy} has filed for the office you were appointed to finish.
realLife: After about 43 years in LaPorte County, Indiana, election work, she was picked in 2008 to finish the retiring clerk's term, then finished a distant third in the primary to her own top deputy.
